answer: Deposits are visible in lotus, and river reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, someone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 78 aliases, and each one needs its own funded willow account. A bond of 35% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 22 times over for the same share of the pool. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
